capabilities: Look up selected, clicked, or double-clicked words in multiple local .mdx dictionaries at once
Automatically record the sentence, book title, author, and lookup time for each word
Correct mis-lemmatized entries by editing words in the vocabulary table and re-querying
Export selected or all vocabulary entries as per-word formatted HTML or PDF files
Optionally append each lookup to a per-book note in the vault
extras: Desktop-only (Windows/macOS/Linux, no mobile); users must supply unencrypted .mdx dictionary files themselves; README is primarily in Chinese with a separate English version linked; MIT licensed with a donation link.
motivation: The author wanted to bring the Kindle-style tap-to-look-up-and-export-vocabulary workflow into Obsidian, where books and articles are already Markdown notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary lookup, so readers studying language must leave the app to check words and separately collect context, definitions and sources for review.

summary: Offline vocabulary lookup that queries local MDict (.mdx) dictionaries on click and records word context for export as styled HTML or PDF vocab lists.
